text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm sorry to say that I failed to achieve first place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But I was able to unleash all the power I currently have, and for that reason, I've no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts on today's result, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You did well to place that high.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Your assistance has contributed a great deal to my being able to finish today's race without any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall devote myself to seizing first place in the next race. Please continue to advise me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …! One must always aim higher… Yes, that's an important lesson. I shall take it to heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I believe that my current weaknesses became quite evident during today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please assist me in creating a training regimen that will put us in good stead for the next race. I look forward to your instruction.
